abort.already_configured: This E.ON Next account is already configured.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: The API key belongs to a different E.ON Next account. Re-authenticate with a key for the original account.
abort.legacy_entry_needs_reauth: An E.ON Next entry from before version 2.0 is waiting to be re-authenticated. Open it under Settings > Devices & services and select Re-authenticate to add your API key, instead of adding the integration again.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to E.ON Next API
error.invalid_auth: E.ON Next rejected the API key. Check it was copied in full (it starts with sk_live_).
error.no_accounts: The API key is valid, but no E.ON Next accounts are linked to it.

reauth_confirm.description: Your E.ON Next login is no longer valid. Entries set up before version 2.0 used an email and password, which E.ON no longer accepts: enter an API key. Otherwise you can leave the field blank to reuse the API key already saved, or paste a new one if it was regenerated or revoked. See [how to create an API key]({api_key_url}).
reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Eon Next

data_description.api_key: Your E.ON Next API key (sk_live_...). It gives full access to your account: keep it private.

user.description: E.ON Next no longer accepts email and password logins for integrations. Sign in with your account's API key instead. See [how to create an API key]({api_key_url}).
user.title: Connect E.ON Next

data.show_panel: Show EON Next dashboard in sidebar
data.show_card: Register EON Next summary card for Lovelace dashboards
data.backfill_rebuild_statistics: Clear and rebuild statistics before backfill (recommended for full history)
data.gas_consumption_in_m3: Gas consumption is reported in m³

data_description.gas_consumption_in_m3: On for SMETS2 gas meters (most smart meters), whose consumption E.ON reports in cubic metres; it is converted to kWh. Turn off for SMETS1 gas meters, which already report kWh.
data_description.gas_calorific_value: Used to convert gas volume to kWh (kWh = m³ × 1.02264 × calorific value ÷ 3.6). Your gas bill shows the value for your area; the default is 38.

init.description: Configure dashboard visibility and backfill settings. Backfill imports historical consumption slowly to avoid API/recorder load.
init.title: EON Next Options
